title: Way Back Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Way Back is a renovated and well maintained pet friendly guest cottage in Seaside with a private location, lush lawn, with two furnished open air porches both up and down all within walking distance to everything Seaside and the beach!
description_expanded: Description552 FOREST STREET1 QUEEN, SLEEPS 2, PET FRIENDLYA Historic Seaside Cottage, Thoughtfully ReimaginedWay Back Cottage is a rare piece of Seaside history—originally the personal residence of Seaside’s first town architect and lovingly preserved for more than three decades. Once a compact pine cabin tucked into the woods, this beloved retreat has been fully updated with modern comforts while retaining its original charm. Recent upgrades include a refreshed kitchen and bathroom, recessed lighting, two-zone air conditioning, upgraded soft furnishings, and the addition of a compact washer and dryer. At just under 450 square feet, Way Back offers a perfectly curated, cozy escape for two adults and a beloved family pet—proof that thoughtful design makes every square foot count.Prime Seaside Location Near Pools, Fitness & Town CenterLocated on quiet Forest Street near the iconic Seaside Chapel, Way Back Cottage enjoys a peaceful setting just steps from Seaside’s most sought-after amenities. The adult and family pools, fitness center, tennis courts, and pickleball courts are just one block away, while the shops and restaurants of downtown Seaside are a scenic five-minute walk from your front door. Meandering sandy paths lined with classic Seaside picket fences lead you easily to the beach for sun-filled days on the Gulf.Outdoor Living Surrounded by Pine Forest SerenityFramed by a pine forest both front and back, Way Back Cottage invites guests to fully embrace outdoor living. Relax in Adirondack chairs on the front terrace, enjoy the shaded entry porch or upper balcony, rinse off in the outdoor shower after a beach day, or grill dinner on the gas BBQ. These thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces extend the living area and enhance the cottage’s tranquil, nature-inspired atmosphere.Cozy Interiors with Modern ComfortsInside, the main level features a compact galley kitchen, dining table, and a welcoming living area with comfortable new seating and a flat-screen smart TV—perfect for unwinding after a day in Seaside. A discreet washer and dryer nook adds everyday convenience without sacrificing space. Upstairs, an easy staircase leads to the open bedroom, complete with a queen bed, flat-screen smart TV, credenza, closet, and a beautifully refreshed bathroom. The spa-like bath includes a walk-in rain shower, heated floors, and a heated towel rail for added comfort.Explore 30A with Ease & Personalized ServiceTwo complimentary rental bikes are included with your stay, making it easy to explore Seaside and the neighboring 30A beach towns via the area’s extensive bike paths and scenic routes along freshwater dune lakes. A dedicated parking space is conveniently located directly in front of the cottage. Concierge services from Homeowner’s Collection are available to enhance your stay, including restaurant reservations, optional beach cabana setups, and pre-arrival grocery stocking.A Beloved Seaside Retreat for Every OccasionWhether you’re planning a romantic beach getaway, a solo reset, a mom-daughter escape, or a relaxing stay for two close friends, Way Back Cottage offers a one-of-a-kind Seaside experience. This pet-friendly, fully updated historic cottage has delighted guests for decades and continues to stand out as one of Seaside’s most cherished rental homes—perfectly blending character, comfort, and coastal charm.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $50 a day rental pet fee will be collected in addition to the flat $100 pet fee.FEATURESJust under 450 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceAccess to Seaside’s private residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion, part of the largest stretch of private residential beaches along Scenic 30AApproximately a 6-minute walk (about 500 yards) to the beach via Seaside’s iconic sandy, picket-fenced pathways and gated East Ruskin Pavilion access5-minute walk to Seaside Central Square and the Seaside Amphitheater, home to over 35 shops, restaurants, and cafésPet-friendly accommodations for one dog up to 20 lbsPeacock Alley Linens, featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the cottageAccess to three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts, and a fitness center (court fees apply where applicable)Welcome tote including two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest services throughout your stay, with starter amenities thoughtfully providedResidential parking permit for one vehicle; golf carts are not permitted except for pre-approved medical needs with a special permit STR23-001928
